finding_key: packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts::`sheets import` silently ignores `--start` for exported `ref,value,formula` csvs, but the agent-facing schema still advertises it unconditionally
evidence: Verified in the supplied files: `sheets-import.ts` branches `isCellTable(rows) ? buildCellMapFromTable(rows) : buildCellMap(rows, startRow, startCol)`, and `buildCellMapFromTable` (csv-parse.ts) keys cells off the `ref` column only, never touching `startRow`/`startCol` — so `--start` is genuinely inert for a `ref,value,formula[,style]` CSV. The `sheets.import` entry in registry.ts still declares `'--start': { type: 'string', required: false, description: 'Top-left cell', default: 'A1' }` with no qualification, while the PR did add that caveat to `packages/cli/skills/sheets-import-export.md` ("imported by reference … and `--start` does not apply"), confirming the registry is the drifted copy. The secondary point — that the by-reference mode is triggered implicitly by header sniffing with no diagnostic, unlike the explicit `--raw` on export — also matches the code. I could not inspect `packages/documentation/developers/cli.md:348` (not supplied and the diff doesn't touch the import options table), so that part of the prose is unverified, but the registry claim alone stands. This is interface/doc drift on the agent-facing schema rather than a runtime bug, so minor.
